admin.scope_help: Select a hero to customize. Every hero can inherit settings (all or some) from the Default one or its parent hero.
admin.reset_confirm: Remove all the settings of "{target}"? Its images will be deleted.
admin.saved_message: The hero settings have been saved.
admin.webp_unsupported: This server cannot encode WebP images (GD or Imagick without WebP support): image uploads will fail.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hidden: Once the welcome banner is closed, this hero is hidden (Flarum's behavior).
preview.discussion_note: Sample tags: on the forum, each discussion shows its own tags and, if enabled, the color of its first tag.
preview.other_subtitle: The heroes of other extensions show their own texts.

other.enabled_label: Customize the heroes of other extensions
other.enabled_help: Off: the heroes of the other extensions (pages, polls…) stay as they are. On: they use the settings of this level, which inherit from Default like the other heroes. Only heroes built on Flarum's hero component are concerned.

background.title: Background image
background.intro: Add an image behind the hero. It is cropped to fit each screen: choose the point to keep in view.
background.tag_hero_label: Use the hero of the discussion's tag
background.tag_hero_help: The background image, overlay and height of the discussion's tag hero (its child tag, else its parent, else "Tags (default)") replace those of this level. Discussions without tags, or whose tags have none of these settings, keep these ones. Choose a sample tag in the preview to check.
background.tag_color_label: Use the tag color as background
background.tag_color_help: Like Flarum: without an image, a discussion takes the color of its first tag, under the overlay. Off: Flarum's hero color.
background.small_image_warning: This image is only {width} px wide: it may look blurry on large screens ({recommended} px or more recommended). It is still used.
background.inherited_image: Image of “{source}”, with this hero's own position.
background.position_help: Click or drag on the image to choose the point to keep visible. The frame shows what the chosen device displays, at the hero's real height.
background.position_x_help: The horizontal position only changes something on: {devices}. Elsewhere, the image already fills the whole width.
background.position_note: For guidance only: the result can vary slightly with the screen, the window size and the text.

image.upload_help: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {size} MB and 4000 px per side. Optimized to WebP.
image.too_large: This image is too large: {size} MB maximum.
image.url_help: The image is downloaded once and stored on your forum.

overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.intro: Lay a color or a gradient over the image (or the hero's color), for example to make the text easier to read.
overlay.corners_help: Each color starts from its corner and blends with the others in the middle. Lower the opacity to see the image through.
overlay.corner_help: The gradient goes diagonally to the opposite corner, whatever the size of the hero.
overlay.angle_help: 0° goes from bottom to top, 90° from left to right, 180° from top to bottom.
overlay.stops_help: Each color has a position along the gradient, from 0 to 100% (for a radial gradient: from the center outwards).

height.title: Height
height.intro: Set the height of the hero on desktop, tablet and mobile.
height.preset_help: Fixed heights on desktop / tablet / mobile: the hero keeps its height whatever the text (title cut after 2 lines, description after 3).
height.auto_help: At least 120 px high on desktop (less on mobile), and the hero expands with its text or logo, like in Flarum.
height.custom_help: From {min} to {max} px ({mobile} px at most on mobile).

logo.title: Logo
logo.intro: Add a logo or an image beside the title, above it or in its place.
logo.intro_discussion: Add a logo or an image beside the title or above it.
logo.add_label: Add a logo to the hero
logo.image_help: Transparency is kept. Stored at most 256 px high (twice the largest size, for sharp screens).
logo.side_help: The logo and the text are placed together, following the text alignment. If you choose "Instead of the title", note that the title is still read by screen readers, and that discussion pages and the heroes of other extensions show the logo above their title.
logo.side_help_discussion: The logo and the text are placed together, following the text alignment.
logo.size_help: A smaller logo keeps its own height: it is never enlarged.
logo.alt_help: Read by screen readers, for example your forum's name. Leave empty if the logo is only decorative.
logo.alt_title_help: Read by screen readers after the title, which stays in the page: leave empty if the logo only shows the title.

text.title: Text
text.intro: Set a title and a description to show on the home hero when Flarum's welcome banner (configurable in Basics) is closed or not activated (no text). You can also hide the hero after Flarum's welcome banner is closed.
text.after_close_label: Once the welcome banner is closed
text.after_close_hero: Keep the hero, with the text below
text.message_help: Plain text, line breaks are kept. Leave both empty for a hero without text (background only).

text_style.title: Text style
text_style.intro: Adjust the alignment, position, size and color of the title and the description.
text_style.intro_discussion: Adjust the alignment, position, size and color of the title.
text_style.tag_icon_help: Before the tag name, for the tags that have an icon (set in the Tags settings).
text_style.tag_description_help: Below the tag name (set in the Tags settings).
text_style.discussion_tags_help: Always right next to the title, before the logo, buttons or icons placed above or below the text. Badges (sticky, locked…) go with them.
text_style.v_align_help: Only visible or applicable on heroes taller than Flarum's default (see Height).
text_style.color_help: A light color on a dark image or overlay keeps the text readable.

socials.title: Social icons
socials.intro: Add clickable icons to the hero banner (social media links).
socials.add_label: Add social icons to the hero
socials.opt_in_help: The default social icons are only shown on the home hero: switch this on to show social icons on these heroes too.
socials.items_help: Icon: a Font Awesome Free class, for example fab fa-github (search the icons). The label names the link for screen readers. Links: https://…, mailto:… or tel:…; web links open in a new tab.

placement.label: Placement
placement.help: In a corner, they sit over the hero and take no space: pick a corner free of text and logo. Buttons and social icons cannot share a corner (below the text, the buttons come first).
placement.help_corners: They sit over the hero and take no space: pick a corner free of text and logo. Buttons and social icons cannot share a corner.
placement.polls_note: Note that if the inherited settings are set to show {items} "below the text", they will not be applied or shown on this hero, because FoF Polls puts its own buttons there (create, edit…). You would need to select one of the corners to show them on the polls pages' heroes.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.intro: Add buttons (sign up, log in or links) to the hero banner.
buttons.opt_in_help: The default buttons are only shown on the home hero: switch this on to show buttons on these heroes too.
buttons.items_help: Log in and Sign up open Flarum's dialogs and are only shown to guests (Sign up is hidden when sign-ups are closed). The preview shows every button.

validation.image_processing_failed: {path}: the image could not be processed. The server may not support WebP.
validation.image_download_failed: {path}: the image could not be downloaded (unreachable or non-public address, or file larger than 5 MB).
validation.image_not_found: {path}: the image was not found, upload it again.
validation.placement_conflict: {path}: buttons and social icons cannot share the same corner.
validation.section_not_allowed: {path}: this section is not allowed here.
validation.stops_order: {path}: color stops must be in ascending order.
